name: derived-resource-origin
title: Derived Resource Origin Capability
creator: killbus
notes: The hermetic cross-plugin HLS acceptance gate is implemented in rulego-indexed-vod@46d981f and passed GitHub CI 33250440019. YouTube source-lease/manifest reuse is implemented in the RuleGo example at 51ad260 and passed CI 33263193567 plus live cold/warm, bounded-member, concurrency, and mpv seek checks. Production uses the shared RuleGo :80 owner via ref://:80 and same-origin HLS/static routes. GET, valid and invalid Range, validators, exact response lengths, and atomic readiness are proven. Interactive Emby/Kodi seek remains user-owned. Real YouTube remains an opt-in probe.
